definition: When a model is too simple or undertrained to capture the underlying patterns in the data.
details: Underfitting produces poor performance on both training and validation data, and is typically addressed by increasing model capacity, training longer, or improving feature representations.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down. Boil it down and it is this: When a model is too simple or undertrained to capture the underlying patterns in the data. Here is why it matters: Underfitting produces poor performance on both training and validation data, and is typically addressed by increasing model capacity, training longer, or improving feature representations. Skill, for a model, is just error pushed down until it is small enough to ignore. That steady, miss-by-miss improvement is Underfitting.
